## Findings refused (with reason)

- unit 11 · ber as "in/with": not adopted in `l`/`i`/morph lemma. The Ming 裏 against 也 elsewhere is only a hint; the published glossary reads ber as "even, also", and the instrumental reading is recorded in the note and the gloss instead.
- unit 25 / 27 · be left unrendered in `i`, kept. The published "for his part" (§§24–42) rests on a Ming 他 that does not say it; the particle stays an open question.
- units 60, 67–71 · "queens" for qatud kept against the house "ladies": the house entry covers Ming 婦人 with no possessor and the glossary marks it unsettled; here the Ming is 娘子 and the possessor is "Ambaγai Qaγan's", where "ladies" would mislead. Flagged for the owner with qatud in QUESTIONS.
- unit 60 · jekes-e γažar-u inerü: the case clash (dative then genitive) is real, but no better reading can be built from the words; `i` ("to the elders' ground for the offering") kept, the note already admits the doubt.
- unit 68–69 · ögteküi/ögtekü mörtei, učiraγ̇asu/kürteġesü: the drafter's reading ("your way not to be given … right that you eat") follows the labels and the Ming word by word; no remembered phrasing found, so kept, still doubtful.
- unit 70 · "Ambaqai Qahan is dead, and you —": the dash and "and" are the drafter's cautious cut; kept, with the §63 parallel added to the note.
- unit 71 · "So they spoke, and so it was said even to Högelün": kept; clumsy, but each part is in the words (keġežü, kürtele, ein keġegdeküi bolbi).
- unit 63 · keġežü as "because": changed (see above), the opposite was refused.
- unit 75/77/82 · idqa- "urge": the stem matches the published idqaba (Ming 勸); kept. The direction of the urging stays unknown.
- unit 50 · bergen/belbisün: `i` kept ("my widow and my sister-in-law"); the "and" is English list punctuation; the doubt is now stated in the note.
- unit 85 · tuγlažu "took up the banner" (Ming (英)頭拿着): kept.
- unit 45/46 · Münlig, Qongqotadai, Ongirad: ṅ is handled inconsistently by the house (Ongiradai, Qongqotan, Münggür), so no rule can be applied; Münlig kept. Raised as a doubt.
- Han characters, `reading` and glyph data are the builder's; not touched.

## Remaining doubts

- unit 11 ber (Ming 裏): "also" or instrumental "with"; the whole sentence of qalqatan/öčilten ("queens for shields … daughters to bear petitions") is a reading of -tan/-ten.
- units 25 and 27: be (Ming 他).
- unit 50: bergen, one phrase with belbisün or two persons, and the owner of the reflexive in deġü-ner(i)-jen.
- units 60, 68–71: the queens' rule and the offering words (jekes-e γažar-u inerü, ögteküi mörtei); unit 70's accusative with üküleġü.
- unit 63: whether keġežü carries a causal sense.
- units 74, 81, 84: -gde- in neġügderün.
- units 30, 5: kötöl (led horse) and qatara- causative (Ming 點).
- Münlig / Ongirad / Qongqotadai spellings (ṅ).

## For the glosser (pass 2 will check)

ba here is "we" (Ming 俺); the published entry ba is "and, both" (并): broaden. eġüsgežü here is "begin, set out" (Ming 起); the published entry is "take a wife" (Ming 取): broaden. kürüġed is now lemma kürü-. qurijaγdaγsan is now qurija-γda-γsan. neġüdkün/jabudqun now carry a separate -d- morph; qataraγ̇ulžu follows the published qatara-.

Reviewer pass 2. Checked by script: `t` and the `words` count of every unit unchanged from pass 1 (500 words, 88 units); every morph bracket still equals the packet Ming gloss; gloss.json keys are exactly the novel-forms keys plus `__broaden__`; every entry matches the format `<dictionary form> — <meaning> (<grammar>) [<Ming gloss>]`; every token of `t` has an entry; every entry's dictionary form matches a lemma of the morphs it serves; every `__broaden__` entry is the old glossary entry whole + " · " + the new reading. - Known entry `boluba` has the lemma bolu-, while morphs read bol- + -ba (the published parts read bol-). Not this part's entry; left.
- Notes' reading of the Ming 來/有來 for saγ̇ulumu, qamtu (一箇), ber (裏), be (他), the queens' rule (units 68-70), nuγ̇un and the -gde- of neġügderün: already flagged as uncertain by the drafter; no better reading is available from the Ming alone.
